infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Laso uses your camera to analyze injuries, scan wounds, and provide guided first-aid assistance.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Laso uses your microphone for hands-free voice triage during medical emergencies.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Laso uses your location to identify nearest emergency clinics and medical facilities.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Laso uses speech recognition to transcribe symptoms during emergency situations.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Laso to access your camera to inspect wounds and injuries.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Laso to locate nearby healthcare clinics and emergency rooms.
